image_description: A close-up studio shot of an intricate, chunky beaded necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features large, textured blue beads with metallic accents, smaller amber and green glass beads, and a central orange oval pendant with a floral or starburst pattern. Silver-tone metal findings and wire loops connect the components.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a product flat-lay; there is no neck or chest visible to test draping.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a distinct, larger orange oval bead acting as a central focal point/pendant.

artifact_observations.location: Blue textured beads on the left side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mesh-like texture on the large blue beads appears slightly repetitive and digitally 'painted' rather than physically woven, with some loss of fine detail at the edges.

artifact_observations.location: Wire loops connecting beads near the center-right
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some wire connections appear to merge into the beads without a clear hole or logical physical attachment point, suggesting slight AI hallucination of physics.

artifact_observations.location: Background edges near the top right beads
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/bleeding between the beads and the white background, typical of generative models struggling with sharp occlusion boundaries.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish it from other jewelry types like bracelets.
To verify that the beads are distinct objects and the wires connecting them are physically continuous and not melting into each other.
To assess the realism of the reflections on the glass beads and the texture of the metal components.

focus_areas: Physical connectivity of wire loops to beads
Consistency of light reflection on glass vs. metal surfaces
Texture realism of the woven/mesh blue beads
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire loops. In AI images, wires often fail to actually enter the bead holes, instead just touching the surface. Check if the shadows cast by the beads onto the white background are consistent with a single light source.
